title: DGV-TC-030 TRACE Profile Conformance Evidence Package
description: Validates the structure and required fields of a dgv_tc_030_evidence.json file produced by a DGV runner after executing the TRACE Level 1 conformance suite against an Only OS gateway session GatewayClaim JWT.

test_card_id.description: The DGV test card identifier this evidence package was produced against.

claim_name.description: Human-readable name of the claim class under test, copied from the test card.

svrnos_layer.description: The SVRNOS governance layer targeted by this test card.

ger_mapping.description: The GER failure code this evidence attests against.

verified_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) at which the conformance run completed and this evidence package was sealed.

benchmark_version.description: The DGV specification version under which this evidence was produced (e.g. "0.5.0").

status.description: Overall certification outcome: "passed" only when all mandatory TRACE modules pass.

trace_level.description: The TRACE conformance level that was evaluated (1 for Level 1, which requires TR-ENV, TR-SIG, TR-RTE, and TR-POL).

gateway_claim_path.description: File-system path or artifact URI of the GatewayClaim JWT that was submitted to the conformance suite.

gateway_claim_eat_profile.description: The EAT profile URI extracted from the GatewayClaim JWT; must equal the canonical TRACE v0.1 profile tag.

tee_provider.description: The TEE or execution environment that produced the runtime measurement in `trace.runtime.platform`. Use "software" when running with CMCP_DEV_MODE=1.

policy_bundle_hash.description: The policy bundle hash extracted from `trace.policy.bundle_hash` in the verified JWT, in the form `sha256:<64 hex chars>`.

audit_chain_root.description: The genesis block hash (root) of the gateway session audit chain, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

audit_chain_tip.description: The most recent block hash (tip) of the gateway session audit chain at verification time, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

audit_chain_length.description: Number of entries in the audit chain from root to tip (inclusive).

module_results.description: Per-module results from the trace-tests runner, one object per executed TRACE module.

module_id.description: The TRACE module identifier as defined in the agentrust-io/trace-tests specification.

passed.description: True if this module's assertions all passed; false if any assertion failed.

mandatory.description: True for Level 1 mandatory modules (TR-ENV, TR-SIG, TR-RTE, TR-POL); false for Phase 2 optional modules.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code if the module failed (e.g. "TRACE-SIG-001"), or null when passed.

details.description: Module-specific assertion details as returned by the trace-tests runner; structure varies per module.

overall_pass_rate.description: Fraction of mandatory modules that passed (e.g. 1.0 when all four Level 1 modules pass, 0.75 when three of four pass). Must be 1.0 for status to be "passed".

conformance_tool_version.description: Semantic version of the agentrust-io/trace-tests package used to run the conformance suite (e.g. "0.1.4").

results.description: Per-case raw evidence entries as written by the DGV runner, one object per test_case in the test card.

settlement_receipt.description: Content-addressed anchor proving this evidence file has not been tampered with. See RECEIPT_VERIFICATION.md for the independent verification procedure.

layer.description: The anchoring layer. "GitOps Cryptographic Registry" means the anchor is the SHA-256 of the evidence file content committed to a public git repository.

anchor_method.description: The hashing method used. sha256-content-hash means SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, 2-space indent, UTF-8).

transaction_id.description: The content hash in the form dgv-sha256:<64 hex chars>. Recompute with: sha256sum of the evidence JSON (sort_keys=True, indent=2).

signature.description: Identical to transaction_id for the sha256-content-hash method. Present for schema compatibility with other anchor methods.

verification_procedure.description: URI of the published verification procedure document.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the receipt was computed.
